text:
sophie: Opened PR #4287 to migrate the Console -> Observability dashboards doc. Changes: rename metrics, add tracing hook example, add SDK snippets for token-level cost/latency breakdowns. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4287. PTAL.

ben: LGTM overall. Quick Q: did you update the dashboard JSON export path? dashboards refer to metric `inference.latency_ms` still in one place.

sophie: Good catch — I updated most but left `dashboard/v2/llm_overview.json` untouched. I'll change it. Also changed cost field from `token_cost` -> `unit_cost_usd` to align with billing API.

ajay: For the SDK snippet, can you show streaming example? People copy the sync snippet and get confused. Something like:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
with client.stream_response(model='rw-1') as stream:
    for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk.text, end='')
```
Also prefer `response_cost` variable naming.

sophie: Added a streaming variant and updated var names. See latest commit. Also added a small note about quantization affecting `p95` numbers.

maria: I can review the tracing hook example. Are we keeping the `trace_id` header name? Previously we used `x-rw-trace-id`.

sophie: Yes, decided to standardize on `x-rw-trace` to match the agent. Updated docs and the code sample. Please check.

lucas: Found a broken internal link: `../sdk/python#examples` -> should be `../sdk/python#usage-examples`. Can fix in PR.

docs-bot: Docs PR #4287 deployed preview at https://deploy.preview.redwood-inference.com/4287 — preview expires in 7 days.

ben: Added two nit comments on wording near cost breakdown table. Also, we should show an example of mapping token usage to billing rows. Maybe include small CSV example.

sophie: Good idea — added a CSV snippet and a quick query for Cost Explorer.
```sql
SELECT order_id, sum(unit_cost_usd) as cost FROM billing.tokens GROUP BY order_id;
```
Need someone from finance to sanity-check the numbers.

maria: I'll loop in @oliver-finance in the PR.

ajay: One more: alerting section — thresholds are in milliseconds but our dashboard moved to seconds. Please confirm units (`latency_p95_s`).

sophie: Switched p95 metric to seconds and updated the labels. Thanks.

lucas: :thumbsup: I'll squash/merge after the finance check and docs-bot preview green.
